data.summary_en: Improves falsifiable recursive-self-improvement measurement via pre-registered M1/M2 two-level accounting distinguishing machine-generated content from machine-originated mechanisms. On NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, depth-limited compositional search generated sq(inv(n))=1/n^2 (held-out R^2=1.0000000; best standard transform -0.546); after auditing/fixing protocol flaws, extrapolation to n=8,9 gave relative error ≈10^-6.
